text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Here I am~ Ines "Big Sis" has arrived~."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear, did you go into hiding? I 
understand being embarrassed about calling 
the wrong name, but please come out~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hello, Goddesses? Have you seen an 
embarrassed girl around here?
